figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Compound 1 exerts neuroprotective activities against an MPTP-damaged PD mouse model. (A) Changes of mouse body weights during
the drug treatment period. (B and C) Motor behavioral performance of mice in the grip test and pole test at different time points after MPTP
administration. The results are expressed as the mean ± SEM (n = 6 or 7). (D) Representative immunoblots and (E) relative intensities of protein
marker TH in ST of mouse brains determined by Western blotting. The results are expressed as the mean ± SEM (n = 4 or 5). Representative slice
images for TH in the striatum of mouse brains and the corresponding statistical graphs are shown in panels F and G, respectively. The scale bar is
500 μm, and the results are expressed as the mean ± SEM (n = 2). *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, and ***P < 0.001 indicate a significant different from the
control group. #P < 0.05, ##P < 0.01, and ###P < 0.001 indicate a significant difference from the MPTP-treated group.
